cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I followed the man in the bright vest through the side gate. Last to finish, first for distance covered. How far did you run?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The marked course. He was a marshal taking a shortcut to the finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, inspecting access routes. How many gates did you check?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I ran the whole course; you came last despite cutting half of it out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I gave the half I ran twice the attention. Name one stretch you studied for as long as I did.

reason: Replace unsupported confidence framing with a specific copied misconception that directs the Drive, retaining seed causality only where it remains understandable in the actual dialogue.
